questions.title: If Bradley Barcola leaves Paris Saint-Germain on a permanent transfer during the 2026 summer transfer window, which club will sign him?
questions.background: Bradley Barcola is a French winger playing for Paris Saint-Germain.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official announcement from Paris Saint-Germain or the receiving club confirming Bradley Barcola’s completed permanent transfer during the 2026 summer transfer window, corroborated by reliable contemporary news reporting. Resolution : Resolve when the transfer is officially confirmed. If more than one permanent transfer occurs during the window, use his first destination after leaving Paris Saint-Germain. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the destination football club.
questions.current_reasoning: Strong 2026-08-22/23 confirmation across BBC Sport, The Independent, Fabrizio Romano, L'Equipe, RMC Sport, and Fabrice Hawkins cements Liverpool as the sole active club for Bradley Barcola while clarifying Arsenal's reduced odds: (1) Barcola was omitted from PSG's squad for a third straight match today (Ligue 1 opener at Rennes), with L'Equipe reporting PSG do not want to risk an injury scuppering a Liverpool deal after signing Ferran Torres, Mika Godts, and Maghnes Akliouche; (2) Romano (Aug 22) explicitly confirmed Liverpool's £50m/£60m bids for Brighton RW Yankuba Minteh are IN ADDITION TO Barcola (who remains the top target with personal terms agreed and daily club talks underway), and BBC Sport (Aug 23) reports a Liverpool-PSG agreement is 'very likely' before Sept 1—yet because Independent/Liverpool Echo/FootballTransfers confirm no formal written bid or fee agreement is finalized against PSG's £145m asking price, we strictly hold Liverpool at our 0.65 cap; (3) Trimming Arsenal 0.17 -> 0.12 (zero club talks with PSG, signed LW Christos Tzolis who starred Friday, and The Independent today notes Arsenal recently explored Juventus's Kenan Yildiz) and Bayern Munich 0.05 -> 0.04, holding Chelsea 0.04 and Manchester City 0.03 (sum = 0.88, 0.12 residual).

questions.title: If Emiliano Martinez leaves Aston Villa on a permanent transfer during the 2026 summer transfer window, which club will he join?
questions.background: Emiliano Martinez is an Argentina international goalkeeper who plays for Aston Villa.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official announcements from the clubs involved, corroborated by reliable sports reporting. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the acquiring club in Martinez's first confirmed permanent transfer away from Aston Villa during the 2026 summer transfer window. Loan moves and unconfirmed transfer reports do not qualify. Resolution Date : The date the permanent transfer is first publicly confirmed. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the acquiring football club.

questions.title: If Enzo Fernandez leaves Chelsea permanently during the 2026 summer transfer window, which club will sign him?
questions.background: Fernandez is a Chelsea midfielder. This question concerns a permanent transfer rather than a loan.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official club announcements or reliable contemporaneous reporting, including Al Jazeera Sport, confirming a completed transfer. Resolution : Resolve to the club that completes Fernandez's permanent transfer from Chelsea during the 2026 summer transfer window. A reported bid, agreement in principle, or loan does not qualify. questions.title: Who will be Norway's reigning monarch on August 29, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official Norwegian Royal House announcements, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting from major news organizations. Resolution Rule : Identify the person legally holding Norway's crown at the beginning of August 29, 2026, local time. Accession determines the answer, regardless of whether an oath-taking ceremony or coronation has occurred. Accepted Answer Format : The sovereign's regnal name, including the ordinal.

questions.title: Which leader will the Kremlin announce as Vladimir Putin’s counterpart for bilateral talks on the Ukraine war at the 2026 SCO summit?
questions.background: The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) holds an annual leaders’ summit, which also provides opportunities for bilateral diplomatic meetings.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official Kremlin statements or reliable news reporting quoting a Kremlin official, published by August 31, 2026. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the leader publicly identified as scheduled to meet Vladimir Putin bilaterally on the sidelines of the 2026 SCO summit to discuss the Ukraine war. The announced meeting schedule determines the answer; the meeting need not have taken place. Accepted Answer Format : The leader’s full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Key Aug 21-22 diplomatic confirmations ahead of the Bishkek SCO summit (Aug 31-Sept 1): (1) Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov confirmed on Aug 21 (EIR News) that Putin will attend Bishkek and stated the Kremlin will announce Putin's bilateral schedule 'in due time' (likely Aug 27-30 via Yuri Ushakov). (3) Local reporting (Al Jazeera Aug 15, Hindustan Times Aug 17) shows an active Moscow-Ankara Ukraine flashpoint after Russia demanded explanations from the US and Turkey over a potential transfer of US weapons held in Turkey to Kyiv. Combining confirmed attendance, the active Ukraine dispute, and the exact 2025 Tianjin SCO Kremlin-briefing precedent lifts Erdogan 0.35 -> 0.44, while Modi (0.23, active US-India Russian oil tariff/sanctions pressure) and Xi (0.19, confirmed attending) remain strong #2/#3 contenders; trimming Lukashenko (0.05) and Tokayev (0.03), sum = 0.94.
